transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for the past nine months. It feels like a persistent, heavy cloud that I just can't seem to shake off.
Have you had any periods of at least two months during the past nine months when you felt back to your usual self, or has the low mood been present most days the whole time?
No, I haven't had any breaks from it at all. This low mood has been there constantly every single day for the entire nine months, and I haven't felt like my usual self even for a short time.
Along with the low mood, have you also had any changes in sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration most days?

My sleep has been awful because I struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly, wake up too early, and even when I sleep a lot, I have nightmares and never feel rested. However, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite, energy, or concentration.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or is it mainly the low mood and sleep problems?

Yes, I've completely lost interest and pleasure in all the things I used to enjoy, so it is definitely both. Alongside my persistent low mood, I've been dealing with those constant sleep struggles—like trouble falling asleep, nightmares, waking up frequently, and feeling unrefreshed—for the entire nine months.
Did these symptoms begin only within the past two years, or have you had this low mood for longer than two years?
No, I haven't had this low mood for longer than two years. It all started about nine months ago, and I've never felt this way before then.
